description: A close-up photograph depicts a large, smooth, rounded bedrock outcrop composed of light grey rock with visible cracks. A small tuft of sparse, dry, greenish-brown vegetation, resembling grass, grows from a fissure near the apex of the rock formation. The upper background shows a clear, bright sky. This image, sourced from S. Kirppu, illustrates "Bare rocks and rock debris" found in Nipfjället, Sweden, and serves as an example for the "Bare rocks, outcrops, cliffs" land cover category, defined as "Bedrock outcrops with little or no high vegetation (< 10%) but can be moss or lichen covered."
